description: This file contains the implementation of the Borland Interbase database driver for the ADOdb PHP library, including class definitions and methods for database transactions, server info retrieval, and query modifications specific to Borland Interbase.

classes.name: ADODB_borland_ibase
classes.description: Driver class for Borland Interbase, handling transactions, server info, and query limit syntax.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_borland_ibase
classes.description: Record set class for Borland Interbase, extending the base Interbase record set.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction, considering transaction mode and maintaining transaction count.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the server dialect and version.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Appends pagination clauses to SQL queries formatted for Borland Interbase.
